title.value: Membership Inference Attacks Against Temporally Correlated Data in Deep Reinforcement Learning
title.justification: The title directly reflects the focus of the paper on evaluating membership inference attacks in the context of deep reinforcement learning.
title.quote:
Membership Inference Attacks Against Temporally
Correlated Data in Deep Reinforcement Learning

extractions.description: This paper addresses the vulnerability of deep reinforcement learning (RL) models to membership inference attacks (MIAs), particularly focusing on the impact of temporally correlated training data. The authors propose an adversarial attack framework to assess this vulnerability and demonstrate its effectiveness in high-dimensional control tasks. The paper explores how the temporal correlation within training data influences privacy risks and examines the performance of different MIAs in both individual and collective data points.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The focus of the paper is on privacy and security related to reinforcement learning models, rather than any specific climate or ecological sustainable development goals.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: The potential success of such MIAs can have serious privacy breaches, which raises concerns in this regard.
